examples.english: I stubbed my toe and it hurts.

examples.japanese: {足指|あしゆび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧⟦ストレッチ→ストレッチ：05239_sutorecchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{足指|あしゆび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{冷|ひ}えて→冷える：01154_hieru⟧⟦{感覚|かんかく}→感覚：02593_kankaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧なくなること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In winter, my toes sometimes get so cold that I lose feeling in them.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧ (foot, leg) + ⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧ (finger, digit). Japanese uses ⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧ for both fingers and toes, so {足指|あしゆび} specifies the toes. Also written as ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧ in everyday speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {足指|あしゆび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{動|うご}かす→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧ — move one's toes
- {足指|あしゆび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{冷|ひ}える→冷える：01154_hieru⟧ — toes get cold
- {足指|あしゆび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧ — between the toes
- {足指|あしゆび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{爪|つめ}→爪：02159_tsume⟧ — toenails

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手指|てゆび}/⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧ — finger; the hand counterpart, specifying fingers rather than toes
- ⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧ — finger/toe; the general word that covers both, with context determining which
- つま{先|さき} — tip of the toes, tiptoe; refers to the front end of the foot rather than individual toes
